name: rtdb-modular-admin-ref-navigation-and-url-errors
description: firebase-admin/database Reference navigation and URL resolution: observes db.ref(), db.ref("/"), db.ref("") throw, child/parent/root/key/toString/toJSON, isEqual() and isEqual(null) throw, and live db.refFromURL() routing plus host-mismatch/fragment/malformed URL throws.

emptyStringRef.message: child failed: path argument was an invalid path = "". Paths must be non-empty strings and can't contain ".", "#", "$", "[", or "]"

isEqualNull.message: Query.isEqual failed: First argument must be an instance of firebase.database.Query.

refFromUrlHostMismatch.message: FIREBASE FATAL ERROR: refFromURL: Host name does not match the current database: (found mismatched-other-instance.firebaseio.com but expected <databaseHost>)

refFromUrlWithFragment.message: refFromURL failed: url argument must be a valid firebase URL and the path can't contain ".", "#", "$", "[", or "]".

refFromUrlMalformed.message: FIREBASE FATAL ERROR: Cannot parse Firebase url. Please use https://<YOUR FIREBASE>.firebaseio.com
